README.md.newer_append: Background persistence and activity commits share a store coordinator through the durable flush and graph epoch update, so a competing commit cannot observe a newer store with an older graph epoch. A refused activity batch restores only changed vector and lexical index entries; unchanged vectors remain resident or in their disk snapshot rather than rebuilding the entire experience group while readers wait.
